resources.name: Jupiter API
resources.description: Complete API flow for Jupiter platform

resources.name: 01 · Auth
resources.description: Registration, login, token refresh and current user

resources.name: Register
resources.description: Create a new user under a tenant. Use an existing tenant_id or run make seed first.

resources.name: Login
resources.description: Authenticate and receive access + refresh tokens. Copy access_token to the environment.

resources.name: Refresh Token
resources.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token pair.

resources.name: Get Current User
resources.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile.

resources.name: 02 · Questions
resources.description: Practice questions scoped to the authenticated tenant

resources.name: List Questions
resources.description: Returns all practice questions for the tenant. Supports ?category=sales&page=1&limit=20

resources.name: List Questions — Filter by Category
resources.description: Filter questions by category. Available: sales, product, communication, objection_handling

resources.name: 03 · Evaluations
resources.description: Full evaluation lifecycle: create → upload → process → results

resources.name: 1. Create Evaluation
resources.description: Creates an evaluation record and returns a presigned MinIO URL for direct video upload. Copy the evaluation id to evaluation_id env var.

resources.name: 2. Upload Video (presigned PUT)
resources.description: Use the upload_url returned by Create Evaluation to upload the video file directly to MinIO. No Authorization header needed — the URL is pre-signed.

resources.name: 3. Complete Evaluation (trigger analysis)
resources.description: Marks the video as uploaded and publishes pose, whisper and prosody jobs to RabbitMQ. Returns 202 Accepted.

resources.name: 4. Get Evaluation (poll for results)
resources.description: Returns current status, score and features. Poll until status=completed.

resources.name: List Evaluations
resources.description: Paginated list of evaluations for the authenticated user. Supports ?status=completed

resources.name: 5. Stream Progress (WebSocket)
resources.description: WebSocket connection for real-time evaluation progress. Events: connected, status_changed, completed, error. Use a WebSocket client (e.g. Insomnia WS tab or wscat).

resources.name: 00 · Health
resources.description: Health checks for all services

resources.name: Gateway Health
resources.description: Returns {"status": "ok"} when the gateway is running.

resources.name: RabbitMQ Management UI
resources.description: RabbitMQ management console. Default credentials: guest / guest

resources.name: MinIO Console
resources.description: MinIO object storage console. Default credentials: minioadmin / minioadmin
